source: Unchanged ascii 1.1.0 Rust files and Cargo.toml, archive-compared; separate dependent harness package uses path ../.. to the artifact root
input_domain: Every valid AsciiChar value (128 values), and every pair (128^2) for equality. The nondeterministic byte <128 condition is exactly this finite type domain, not a sample bound.
generator: Call original safe AsciiChar::new(char::from(code)); assert original public as_byte returns exactly that code before testing each API. This confirms complete representation coverage and introduces no invalid enum state.
observations: Direct original public calls; immutable results or mutated local value observed with original public as_byte/as_char. No implementation copy, private-field accessor, manual source adaptation or raw-memory observer.

body_harnesses.uppercase_full_ascii_domain: to_ascii_uppercase maps a-z to A-Z and preserves other codes
body_harnesses.lowercase_full_ascii_domain: to_ascii_lowercase maps A-Z to a-z and preserves other codes
body_harnesses.make_uppercase_full_ascii_writeback: make_ascii_uppercase writes that exact uppercase value to the mutable receiver
body_harnesses.make_lowercase_full_ascii_writeback: make_ascii_lowercase writes that exact lowercase value to the mutable receiver
body_harnesses.as_char_full_ascii_domain: as_char returns the Unicode scalar with the identical ASCII code
body_harnesses.case_insensitive_equality_full_pair_doma: eq_ignore_ascii_case equals equality after mathematical A-Z-to-a-z code folding
body_harnesses.printable_picture_full_ascii_domain: as_printable_char maps controls 0..31 to U+2400..U+241F, DEL to U+2421, and other codes to their identical character

bounds: No sample or unwind override; target paths and reference formulas contain no loops. All integer arithmetic/safety assertions are checked for the entire stated scalar domains.
unsafe_boundary: The safe input constructor is checked on valid ASCII inputs. The printable-picture body uses its original unchecked char constructor, whose executions remain within valid Unicode points under the proved domain; invalid AsciiChar states are never created. This is not a guarantee about arbitrary unchecked integer-to-enum calls.
partial_constructor_result: The generator also checks new for ASCII char inputs. Non-ASCII constructor panic behavior is outside these harness domains, so new is not marked fully verified.
tool_separation: These direct Rust body checks do not remove the observed Aeneas Char-cast emission blocker. They are not additional Aeneas machine claims or a Kani-to-Lean equivalence proof.
